name: Masterplanning Studio
tagline: Trace a site boundary from satellite imagery and get a plot/road layout, 3D massing, and feasibility report.
description: Traces a site from satellite imagery, auto-generates a road and plot subdivision layout with a live-updating spine road, snaps it into a 3D massing model, runs a climate and vastu analysis, and exports a client feasibility and financial report as a PDF.

page.objective: Take a raw site boundary to a feasibility-ready master plan without manual plot subdivision.
page.problem: Laying out roads and plots on a raw site, then re-checking feasibility whenever the layout changes, is normally a slow manual iteration.
page.solution: The site is traced from satellite imagery, the road and plot layout auto-generates and updates live, and a massing plus feasibility report follow from the same model.

highlights.headline: Site trace to plot layout to massing to feasibility PDF in one pass.
points: Traces the site boundary from satellite imagery rather than a manually drawn outline.
Auto-generates a spine road and plot layout that updates live as the road is adjusted.
Runs a climate and vastu analysis (sun path, wind rose) alongside the massing.
Exports a client feasibility and financial report directly as a PDF.
